sqlite_master.name: board_goal_requests_out_seq_insert
sqlite_master.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER board_goal_requests_out_seq_insert AFTER INSERT ON board_goal_requests_out BEGIN INSERT INTO board_goal_meta (board_id, seq, updated_at) VALUES (NEW.board_id, 1, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'))
		ON CONFLICT(board_id) DO UPDATE SET seq = seq + 1, updated_at = excluded.updated_at; END

sqlite_master.name: board_goal_requests_out_seq_update

CREATE TRIGGER board_goal_requests_out_seq_update AFTER UPDATE OF status ON board_goal_requests_out WHEN OLD.status IS NOT NEW.status BEGIN INSERT INTO board_goal_meta (board_id, seq, updated_at) VALUES (NEW.board_id, 1, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'))
		ON CONFLICT(board_id) DO UPDATE SET seq = seq + 1, updated_at = excluded.updated_at; END

sqlite_master.name: board_goals_seq_closed
sqlite_master.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER board_goals_seq_closed AFTER UPDATE OF state ON board_goals WHEN NOT (OLD.state IN ('done', 'dropped')) AND (NEW.state IN ('done', 'dropped'))
			BEGIN INSERT INTO board_goal_meta (board_id, seq, updated_at) VALUES (NEW.board_id, 1, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'))
		ON CONFLICT(board_id) DO UPDATE SET seq = seq + 1, updated_at = excluded.updated_at; INSERT INTO board_goal_events (board_id, goal_id, kind, seq, at) SELECT NEW.board_id, NEW.id, 'goal_closed', seq, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now') FROM board_goal_meta WHERE board_id = NEW.board_id AND (1); END

		ON CONFLICT(board_id) DO UPDATE SET seq = seq + 1, updated_at = excluded.updated_at; INSERT INTO board_goal_events (board_id, goal_id, kind, seq, at) SELECT OLD.board_id, OLD.id, 'goal_deleted', seq, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now') FROM board_goal_meta WHERE board_id = OLD.board_id AND (1); END

CREATE TRIGGER board_goals_seq_insert AFTER INSERT ON board_goals BEGIN INSERT INTO board_goal_meta (board_id, seq, updated_at) VALUES (NEW.board_id, 1, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'))
		ON CONFLICT(board_id) DO UPDATE SET seq = seq + 1, updated_at = excluded.updated_at; INSERT INTO board_goal_events (board_id, goal_id, kind, seq, at) SELECT NEW.board_id, NEW.id, 'goal_created', seq, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now') FROM board_goal_meta WHERE board_id = NEW.board_id AND (1); END

sqlite_master.name: board_goals_seq_reopened
sqlite_master.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER board_goals_seq_reopened AFTER UPDATE OF state ON board_goals WHEN (OLD.state IN ('done', 'dropped')) AND NOT (NEW.state IN ('done', 'dropped'))
			BEGIN INSERT INTO board_goal_meta (board_id, seq, updated_at) VALUES (NEW.board_id, 1, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'))
		ON CONFLICT(board_id) DO UPDATE SET seq = seq + 1, updated_at = excluded.updated_at; INSERT INTO board_goal_events (board_id, goal_id, kind, seq, at) SELECT NEW.board_id, NEW.id, 'goal_reopened', seq, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now') FROM board_goal_meta WHERE board_id = NEW.board_id AND (1); END

sqlite_master.name: board_goals_seq_update
sqlite_master.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER board_goals_seq_update AFTER UPDATE OF title, outcome, done_when, state, blocked_on, driver, closed_at, closed_reason ON board_goals
			WHEN (OLD.title IS NOT NEW.title OR OLD.outcome IS NOT NEW.outcome OR OLD.done_when IS NOT NEW.done_when OR OLD.state IS NOT NEW.state OR OLD.blocked_on IS NOT NEW.blocked_on OR OLD.driver IS NOT NEW.driver
			OR OLD.closed_at IS NOT NEW.closed_at OR OLD.closed_reason IS NOT NEW.closed_reason) AND ((OLD.state IN ('done', 'dropped')) = (NEW.state IN ('done', 'dropped')))
			BEGIN INSERT INTO board_goal_meta (board_id, seq, updated_at) VALUES (NEW.board_id, 1, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'))
		ON CONFLICT(board_id) DO UPDATE SET seq = seq + 1, updated_at = excluded.updated_at; INSERT INTO board_goal_events (board_id, goal_id, kind, seq, at) SELECT NEW.board_id, NEW.id, 'goal_updated', seq, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now') FROM board_goal_meta WHERE board_id = NEW.board_id AND (1); END

CREATE TRIGGER board_goals_uid_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF goal_uid ON board_goals WHEN OLD.goal_uid IS NOT NEW.goal_uid
			BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a goal uid is never changed'); END

board_tasks_goal_seq_delete
sqlite_master.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER board_tasks_goal_seq_delete AFTER DELETE ON board_tasks WHEN OLD.goal_id IS NOT NULL BEGIN INSERT INTO board_goal_meta (board_id, seq, updated_at) VALUES (OLD.board_id, 1, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'))
		ON CONFLICT(board_id) DO UPDATE SET seq = seq + 1, updated_at = excluded.updated_at; INSERT INTO board_goal_events (board_id, goal_id, kind, seq, at) SELECT OLD.board_id, OLD.goal_id, 'task_unlinked', seq, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now') FROM board_goal_meta WHERE board_id = OLD.board_id AND (1); END

sqlite_master.name: board_tasks_goal_seq_insert

CREATE TRIGGER board_tasks_goal_seq_insert AFTER INSERT ON board_tasks WHEN NEW.goal_id IS NOT NULL BEGIN INSERT INTO board_goal_meta (board_id, seq, updated_at) VALUES (NEW.board_id, 1, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'))
		ON CONFLICT(board_id) DO UPDATE SET seq = seq + 1, updated_at = excluded.updated_at; INSERT INTO board_goal_events (board_id, goal_id, kind, seq, at) SELECT NEW.board_id, NEW.goal_id, 'task_linked', seq, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now') FROM board_goal_meta WHERE board_id = NEW.board_id AND (1); END

sqlite_master.name: board_tasks_goal_seq_move
sqlite_master.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER board_tasks_goal_seq_move AFTER UPDATE OF goal_id ON board_tasks WHEN OLD.goal_id IS NOT NEW.goal_id
			BEGIN INSERT INTO board_goal_meta (board_id, seq, updated_at) VALUES (NEW.board_id, 1, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'))
		ON CONFLICT(board_id) DO UPDATE SET seq = seq + 1, updated_at = excluded.updated_at; INSERT INTO board_goal_events (board_id, goal_id, kind, seq, at) SELECT NEW.board_id, OLD.goal_id, 'task_unlinked', seq, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now') FROM board_goal_meta WHERE board_id = NEW.board_id AND (OLD.goal_id IS NOT NULL); INSERT INTO board_goal_events (board_id, goal_id, kind, seq, at) SELECT NEW.board_id, NEW.goal_id, 'task_linked', seq, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now') FROM board_goal_meta WHERE board_id = NEW.board_id AND (NEW.goal_id IS NOT NULL); END

sqlite_master.name: board_tasks_goal_seq_state

CREATE TRIGGER board_tasks_goal_seq_state AFTER UPDATE OF status ON board_tasks WHEN OLD.goal_id IS NEW.goal_id AND NEW.goal_id IS NOT NULL AND OLD.status IS NOT NEW.status
			BEGIN INSERT INTO board_goal_meta (board_id, seq, updated_at) VALUES (NEW.board_id, 1, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'))
		ON CONFLICT(board_id) DO UPDATE SET seq = seq + 1, updated_at = excluded.updated_at; INSERT INTO board_goal_events (board_id, goal_id, kind, seq, at) SELECT NEW.board_id, NEW.goal_id, 'task_state', seq, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now') FROM board_goal_meta WHERE board_id = NEW.board_id AND (1); END
